listing.name: Left 4 Dead 2 (Xbox 360) — Left 4 Dead 2 — PC Port (Xbox 360 recompilation) (CyberLifeYT)
listing.summary: The Accurate ROV renderer is required for correct lighting and video. A full campaign has not been confirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Left 4 Dead 2 (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Title 454108D4; 1:1 Xbox 360 disc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the Windows launcher to import your own Left 4 Dead 2 disc and download the selected port patch. This guide has not confirmed whether game code is included or built locally; check upstream’s setup instructions before proceeding.

warnings: The Accurate ROV renderer is required for correct lighting and video. A full campaign has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
